parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: discount_amount
parameters.description: The discount amount set for this particular voucher. Only fill in when you are updating a fix amount voucher.

parameters.name: display_channel_list
parameters.description: The FE channel where the voucher will be displayed. The available values are: 1: display_all, 2: order page, 3: feed, 4: live streaming, [] (empty - which is hidden).

parameters.name: display_start_time
parameters.description: The timing of when voucher is displayed on shop pages; so buyer is allowed to claim.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: The timing until when the voucher is still valid. Any time after this end_time, buyer is not allowed to claim or to use.

parameters.name: item_id_list
parameters.description: The list of items which is applicable for the voucher. Only fill in when you are updating a product type of voucher.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: The max amount of discount/value a user can enjoy by using this particular voucher. Only fill in when you are updating a discount percentage voucher or coins cashback voucher.

parameters.name: min_basket_price
parameters.description: The minimum spend required for using this voucher.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: percentage
parameters.description: The discount percentage set for this particular voucher. Only fill in when you are updating a discount percentage voucher or coins cashback voucher.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The timing from when the voucher is valid; so buyer is allowed to claim and to use. Field can only be updated if voucher has not started.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: usage_quantity
parameters.description: The number of times for this particular voucher could be used.

parameters.name: voucher_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the voucher which is going to be updated.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
